text:
Maya D: quick sync from retro: we hit a concrete problem attributing GPU cost when batches mix tenants behind the shared gateway. want to lock a pragmatic approach.

Ali K: please outline the exact mis-attribution we're seeing.

Maya D: scenario: tenant A request hits gw, batches with tenant B on GPU. our billing pipeline attributes GPU-ms to the gateway host today, and we try to split later by joining request logs. heavy joins, sometimes double-counting tails when retries happen.

Samir P: technical nutshell: per-batch resource usage (gpu-ms, mem) is observed at host level. mapping that down to tenants post-hoc explodes cardinality and query cost.

Jen L: product wants per-tenant cost. exact lineage (emit per-token events) would solve it but adds huge telemetry volume.

Ali K: compromise idea: emit a bounded "batch_summary" event from the gateway with tenant token counts and aggregated resource numbers. cheaper than per-token, still proportional.

Maya D: prototype schema suggestion inside thread: ``batch_summary:{batch_id,batch_ts,node_id,region,total_gpu_ms,tenant_token_counts:"A:120,B:30",exclusive_flag:false}``. keep it stringy and compact.

Samir P: pros: bounded cardinality, easy to roll up. cons: retries/duplicates can skew numbers. we need strong dedupe by batch_id and first-wins semantics at ingest.

Jen L: also include region and model_pool tags so dashboards can break down by region/pool. otherwise cross-region failover will confuse finance views.

Ali K: fallback for old clients: if tenant_token_counts missing, attribute by recent request-count ratio for that tenant on the same node within a small window. documentable fallback.

Maya D: audit path: keep this as realtime default for cost dashboards, but support an on-demand lineage backfill pipeline that can re-run exact attribution for specific time ranges when finance/audit requires it.

Samir P: implement plan: ingest dedupe+ttl this sprint (small change), schema + SDK helper next sprint, backfill pipeline in 2-3 sprints.

Jen L: also calling out exclusive pinning: if a batch_summary has exclusive=true or model_pool marked pinned to tenant -> attribute 100% to that tenant. avoids weird prorating for pinned pools.

Ali K: I'll ask Finance if prorated GPU-ms is acceptable as final charge or if they want nightly reconciliation.

Maya D: action items: Maya write RFC follow-up with schema examples and query snippets, Jen add dashboard query examples, Samir land dedupe infra change, Ali ping finance.

obsv-bot: deploy-bot: draft RFC pushed to //git.redwood/infr/obs/batch-summary-rfc.md. please review.

Jen L: noted. i'll open the PR for schema today.

Maya D: thanks all :pray:
